newsitem.title: FRANCE: French civil, military aircraft integration key - PM.
newsitem.headline: French civil, military aircraft integration key - PM.

text.p: French Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said on Saturday that he believed it was necessary to bring togther France's civil and military aircraft activities.
"Already, I can tell you that I consider it essential to bring together the civil and military capabilities in the aeronautical sector," Jospin said in a speech at the Paris air show.
Industry executives had been eager to find out the government's plans for state-owned Aerospatiale and warplane maker Dassault Aviation.
Aerospatiale makes most of its money from building passenger aircraft for the Airbus Industrie consortium.
Under the previous conservative government, Aerospatiale and Dassault were due to have merged and then be privatised, as part of a defence industry consolidation.
